_meta.identityConfidenceReason: Confirmed via official website https://www.plasmenai.wales/ (301-redirected from plasmenai.co.uk), which gives name 'Plas Menai - The National Outdoor Centre', address, phone, email and full activity list. Site is operated as Wales's National Outdoor Centre for watersports (governed under Sport Wales / Welsh Government activity centre network, same family as Plas y Brenin).
redFlags: Operator is a North Wales / Snowdonia (Menai Strait, Caernarfon) watersports centre — it does NOT serve pembrokeshire, brecon-beacons, gower, south-wales, or mid-wales. Combo pages in those regions referencing this operator are a real region mismatch and should be corrected/removed.

Anglesey and llyn-peninsula are plausible adjacent-service regions (Plas Menai sits directly on the Menai Strait facing Anglesey and near the Llyn Peninsula) but this was not explicitly confirmed on the operator's own site as a stated 'service area' — treat as reasonable geographic inference, not confirmed marketing claim.
Could not source a Google/TripAdvisor rating or review count (TripAdvisor page blocked fetch with 403) — left as null rather than guessed.

Site describes itself primarily as 'The National Outdoor Centre' and courses/accommodation venue rather than a typical commercial tour operator; confirm this fits the directory's operator content model before publishing.

proposedOperatorData.description:
Plas Menai is Wales's National Outdoor Centre, based on the shore of the Menai Strait at Griffiths Crossing near Caernarfon, directly facing Anglesey. It runs RYA-recognised courses in sailing, powerboating, windsurfing, windfoiling, stand-up paddleboarding and sea kayaking, spanning beginner to instructor-training level, alongside youth courses, shore-based theory and water rescue training.

The centre also runs recreational adventure weeks, discovery sessions, and community sailing/windsurfing/SUP clubs, plus school activity days and corporate team-building. On-site, dog-friendly accommodation with full-board catering, a health and fitness suite, and a restaurant/bar are available, making it a residential activity venue as well as a day-course provider.

As a National Outdoor Centre (part of the same publicly-funded network as Plas y Brenin), its core service area is the Menai Strait and North Wales coast around Caernarfon and Anglesey, not South or Mid Wales.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: Wales's dedicated National Watersports Centre, offering RYA-accredited courses from beginner to instructor level with on-site residential accommodation on the Menai Strait.
